title: Mobile Health (mHealth) Viral Diagnostics Enabled with Adaptive Adversarial Learning
summary: Adaptive adversarial image classifiers plus StyleGAN augmentation supported phone-based detection across five virus targets in 179 patient samples; the SARS-CoV-2 test panel had 62 nasal swabs and reported 100% sensitivity and specificity, with confidence intervals and a single study setting limiting interpretation.
ai_technology: Conditional adversarial neural networks adapt image classifiers across virus domains; StyleGAN produces synthetic images for the unlabeled target library.
organization: Division of Engineering in Medicine, Department of Medicine, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, Massachusetts 02139, United States

evidence.tested: Results report 179 patient samples across five targets; SARS-CoV-2 panel n=62 reports 100% sensitivity/specificity and corresponding confidence intervals.
evidence.unknown: Independent test set uses patient samples and compares SARS-CoV-2 panel with qRT-PCR; evidence remains one study panel, not external deployment.
evidence.ai_role: Conditional adversarial neural networks adapt image classifiers across virus domains; StyleGAN produces synthetic images for the unlabeled target library.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
